name: Official TypeSafe skill
description: Official agent skill for choosing primitives, composing typed decisions, and evaluating integrations.

name: TypeSafe Python SDK
description: Official Python client; its quickstart routes a support ticket using a typed Choice.

name: TypeSafe JavaScript SDK
description: Official JavaScript and TypeScript client with answer types inferred from named questions.

name: Jevify
description: Reusable discovery skill that finds Jev opportunities, designs question packs, and proposes comparison experiments.
notes: Independent skill, not the model or an official SDK.

name: Jev Logs
description: Scores log records with typed questions to route selected records for deeper analysis while preserving the archive.

name: Skillbox
description: Self-hosted versioned skill library with optional Jev-based task-aware recommendations and deterministic fallback.
notes: Jev is an optional recommender, not required for the core library.

name: Jev Ultrafast
description: Selects browser operation and observed DOM target with Jev; a separate model generates typing text.
notes: Published timing is a narrow author-run demonstration, not a general reliability guarantee.

name: Foreman
description: Uses independent Noul checks to supervise a coding worker while deterministic policy decides interventions.
notes: Architectural experiment; its README provides an offline deterministic demo.

name: Jev MCP
description: MCP tools use Jev to verify claims against evidence, screen incoming content, and rank candidates.
notes: Review tool permissions and environment handling before installation.

name: TypeSafe MCP
description: Go MCP server exposing typed Jev judgments to coding agents, with documented client setup and retries.

name: Home Assistant Jev
description: Turns Jev probability, choice, and score answers into Home Assistant entities and automation results.
notes: Inspect the example automations and keep consequential actions behind explicit policy.

name: Jev Plays Snake
description: Code computes legal moves and board facts; Jev chooses one direction per game tick.
notes: Useful separation of legal-action generation, model choice, deadlines, and local execution.

name: JevPilot
description: Three.js driving simulation where Jev selects from locally generated steering and speed candidates.
notes: Simulation only; not an autonomous-driving safety system. The hosted demo may require login.

name: TypeSafe Mario
description: An emulator-state parser supplies structured telemetry; Jev selects bounded NES controller inputs.
notes: Requires a lawful local game setup; repository does not include Nintendo ROMs.

name: PROMPT FPS / Jev Doom
description: Chocolate Doom WASM instances expose structured state; Jev chooses tactical macros executed by local controllers.
notes: Ships Freedoom, not commercial Doom assets. Engine and content have separate GPL/BSD notices; inspect licenses/.

name: Jev Music Playground
description: Jev selects composition enums; deterministic code expands them into notation, playback, and MIDI.
notes: Includes an explicitly labeled offline heuristic mode; Jev does not directly generate audio.

name: OpenJev SGLang
description: Independent API-compatible typed-decision server using open-model label probabilities through SGLang.
notes: Not official Jev weights; no requests go to TypeSafe. Review deployment authentication and GPU costs.
